page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: magnum bellum inciderunt. Eo bello omnes, qui inter Lavicam flumen & Dullartum sinum sunt, exceptis, qui Præfecturam veterem tenent, & cum his bona Drentinorum pars, in civitatem conjurarunt, nec ante destitere, quàm acceptis illatisque gravibus detrimentis anno demum sexto post arma sumptaM. CCC. XXXVIII.[?] summis viribus in civitatem euntes in eas eam angustias & necessitatem adegere, ut ipsa intercessorum arbitrio submittere se-se, & deditionem facere coacta sit.Vrbs dedita. Conditiones dictæ duæ asperæ ac duræ parentando hostium odio: prior, ut pars muri oppidani longo tractu à porta Ebbingana versus portam Esteranam[?] deiceretur, locus ligneo septo rursum clauderetur: altera, ut sex in urbe domus ex lateritio opere firmæ & sublimes, turrium aut arcium instar, ad medium usque fornicem, ne novis turbis occasioni essent, humiliores fierent. Reliquæ æquiores; quales hæ, ut vetusta pacta & fœdera inter partes servarentur, omnibus jura sua cum jurisdictionibus integra utrimque manerent, oppidani agrarijs in defendendâ [?]libertate[?] auxilio essent, in collybi & commer-

page.notes: Marginal note "M. CCC. XXXVIII." : the first letter is doubtful and is marked [?]. The word "Esteranam" has an unclear first letter, marked [?]. The word "libertate" is printed bold and blurred, marked [?]. The left-margin marks show "Conditiones pacis." beside the second paragraph line, partly cut off on the scan; it is read as "Conditiones pacis." The final word "commerciorum" is split across the line end; the second part is "ciorum". Running head and page number are printed as shown. A Google watermark at the lower right and a mark at the lower left are not printed text and are omitted.
